question: When can a saved Windows 10 probe log be reused, and when does the probe have to run on Windows again?
allowedInputs: The tree, including tools/syscall-diff/Invoke-Diff.ps1, tools/graphics-diff/Invoke-GraphicsDiff.ps1, tools/kernel-abi/Invoke-KernelAbi.ps1, and their probe sources
The user request to probe Windows 10 only when the probe would collect new data

cursor.prompt: Let's update our probe scripts to only require probing Windows 10 if the probe has changed. We want to make a way to know if the probe is going to collect new data. Otherwise, the log we already have is good because we aren't making changes to Windows 10.

measuredEffect.note: No guest was booted and no probe percent was recaptured. The self-test adopted a finished log, detected a source change, detected a replaced log, and accepted a stamp written after a finished capture.
